report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator's faulty-deployment hypothesis. Traces show all sampled checkout flows returning 200 with healthy inventory, payment and postgres spans. Order metrics show 8 successful /v1/orders 200s on v1.0.0 and zero 502s; the only deployment record is the baseline v1.0.0 with no previous version. No current evidence establishes a bounded cause, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Error logs or traces showing actual checkout failures (order logs were excluded from context)
Deployment history showing a version change preceding the alleged errors
Metrics or traces with non-2xx checkout/order responses to confirm an incident exists
